name: Dino Trail (Slóeðla)
comment: Slóeðla's song game (engine/sloedla): 75.6 s of chapter 2's Dino Trail (kafli2/theme.mp3 from 25.40 s, a 0.5 s fade in and a 3.5 s fade out from 72.1 s), cut where the song keeps a steady beat (its first 16 s do not sit on one grid). Re-encoded 96 kbps stereo 44.1 kHz with ffmpeg; bpm and beatOffset measured on this file with tools/theme-tempo.mjs --file. Key: chapter 2's, the owner's pick by ear (B-flat pentatonic, root first).
